mutations.why: SURVIVED ITS FIRST SWEEP, and the survival named a real hole. `migrate-legacy-envelope.test.ts` reaches the cipher only THROUGH the use case, which refuses the canonical format before the cipher is ever called — so the double's own format rule was unreachable from the one suite that drives it.
